#!/bin/bash
set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/_xm_front_sync
echo '=== 同步 memory.html ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/dd71788b5a310ad20b1e3ad80600292df556c087/memory.html' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/memory.html?ref=dd71788b5a310ad20b1e3ad80600292df556c087' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || { echo '下载失败: memory.html'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != 'f6a15881f21c2589c9091034add9e625855d3a4c80a2b4303a097a936df482a6' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=f6a15881f21c2589c9091034add9e625855d3a4c80a2b4303a097a936df482a6"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph-view.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/cc78f1a3974ea9feb0853abebc62261723dd2e26/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js?ref=cc78f1a3974ea9feb0853abebc62261723dd2e26' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != 'bff28b1d72dd73f6405b52bcab8f013c9f3f8d6c6aa5d77a79d5efb9964bc3cc' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=bff28b1d72dd73f6405b52bcab8f013c9f3f8d6c6aa5d77a79d5efb9964bc3cc"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/a4d83267bd7601a8faf065fef4dd5b608f2b97be/assets/js/memory-graph.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph.js?ref=a4d83267bd7601a8faf065fef4dd5b608f2b97be' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '7c63ec08172a1dbca66ac48cc53c8608f9cc8d3718c099b03a8a9de5f0307f53' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=7c63ec08172a1dbca66ac48cc53c8608f9cc8d3718c099b03a8a9de5f0307f53"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js'
echo '=== 同步 assets/css/memory-graph.css ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/9dd2816adacbe46c2bee759476cb7fc2d01b7328/assets/css/memory-graph.css' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/css/memory-graph.css?ref=9dd2816adacbe46c2bee759476cb7fc2d01b7328' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 || { echo '下载失败: assets/css/memory-graph.css'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '26a8760f046b2d78ca4a5f5f93f335e039fb4605baf082810891aedf94425109' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=26a8760f046b2d78ca4a5f5f93f335e039fb4605baf082810891aedf94425109"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_3 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'

rm -rf /tmp/_xm_front_sync
